title: Laya with its own Jev-compatible server (pip)
slug_note: Convai's laya-serve: the same /v1/systemone shape as TypeSafe Jev on port 8000.

variation.quant_detail: Full checkpoints (English 421M, multilingual 322M, typed-decisions 421M), loaded by the laya package

engine.config: laya-serve from the laya Python package (not a general LLM engine)

requirements.notes: Estimate: the three checkpoints total 2.32 GB on disk; LAYA_PRELOAD=1 loads them all.

steps.text: It binds 0.0.0.0:8000 with no authentication unless LAYA_API_KEY is set (card). Drop LAYA_DEVICE=cuda to run on CPU.

caveats: Decision model: it answers typed questions with probabilities on /v1/systemone; it does not chat, so OpenCode and chat UIs cannot use it.
Laya's own card: the base checkpoints are near chance on typed decisions zero-shot (0.362); the fine-tuned typed-decisions checkpoint reaches 0.766. Fine-tune on your own decisions.
The card says the checkpoints ship over-confident; refit temperature on your own data before trusting the probabilities.
